skills.title: Alarm
skills.description: Sets alarms in your phone's Clock app when you ask Risi.
can: Set a one-time or repeating alarm on the phone you asked from
cannot: Delete or change an alarm (you remove it in Clock)
Set an alarm on anyone else's phone

permissions.name: com.android.alarm.permission.SET_ALARM
permissions.label: Set alarms in your Clock app

skills.title: Reminders
skills.description: Reminds you, or people who tap Me too, at a time you choose.
can: Remind you with a notification and a message in the chat
Let others in an Official chat tap Me too
cannot: Remind anyone who didn't tap Me too

permissions.name: risi.reminders
permissions.label: Post reminder messages in your chats with Risi

skills.title: Calendar
skills.description: Checks when you're free and adds events to your phone's calendar.
can: See when you're busy (never titles or attendees)
cannot: Read event titles, attendees or places
Change or delete events it didn't add

skills.title: Scheduled messages
skills.description: Sends a message you wrote, from your phone, at the time you choose.
can: Schedule a message, once or every day
cannot: Send from the server (your phone sends it, encrypted at that moment)

permissions.name: android.permission.SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM
permissions.label: Send at the exact time (Alarms & reminders)

skills.title: Email
skills.description: Reads your email when you ask (Gmail or Outlook). Coming later.
cannot: Send email without a full-draft confirm
